text: The purpose of this report is to request authority to amend Purchase Order Number 6049287 with AECOM Canada Ltd., (AECOM) for additional professional services associated with the Crescent Town Pedestrian Bridge Rehabilitation in the amount of $363,022 net of all taxes and charges ($369,411 net of HST recoveries).

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 71-11.1.C of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 71 (Financial Control By-Law), granted authority to amend Purchase Order No. 6049287 with AECOM Canada Ltd., for the provision of professional services for contract administration and site inspection services during construction of the Crescent Town Pedestrian Bridge Rehabilitation by an additional amount of $363,022 net of all taxes and charges ($369,411 net of HST recoveries), revising the current contract value from $139,182 net of all taxes and charges ($141,632 net of HST recoveries) to $502,204 net of all taxes and charges ($511,043 net of HST recoveries).
